Claim 281 (Currently amended): A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer located on opposite sides of a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with each other; and an additional adhesive layer, wherein the additional adhesive layer is positioned between the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

Claim 282 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a composite material.

Claim 283 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a honeycomb structure.

Claim 284 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further including a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers.

Claim 285 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the additional adhesive layer is configured to be cured on the first layer and the second layer.

Claim 286 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are configured to be cured to each other.

Claim 287 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the tool has a circular shape.

Claim 288 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located in registration with the medial section. 

Claim 290 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, wherein the additional adhesive layer is configured to be cured to the medial section.

Claim 291 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 290, wherein the ring includes a central opening.
